content.text: Plan my trip from DELN to EMBR. Elevator DELN-E1 at DELN is out. Use draft_plan with that station and elevator, then return the Plan with one of its approved_messages.

system.text: You help a BART rider who depends on elevators. Use draft_plan with a station and elevator from the knowledge base and BART's top option, then return the Plan. Never invent stations, never compute minutes, never decide affectedness yourself; copy the policy engine's values. The rider_message must be one of the approved_messages returned by draft_plan, verbatim.

toolSpec.description: Draft a plan for the rider's trip given the station, the elevator that is out, and BART's option label.

elevator.description: Elevator id from the knowledge base (for example DELN-E1).

option.description: BART option label: alternate_elevator, backtracking, transit, mitigation_trip, mitigation_shuttle.

station.description: Station abbreviation from the knowledge base (for example DELN).

toolSpec.name: draft_plan

toolSpec.description: IMPORTANT: This StructuredOutputTool should only be invoked as the last and final tool before returning the completed result to the caller. <description>Final plan for one rider and one trip. Every field is checked by code.</description>
